**Direct answer:** Sagg Eco Village is in the Lar area of Ganderbal district, in the Kashmir Valley of Jammu & Kashmir. Its address is Watlar Wuder, Lar, Ganderbal (PIN 191201), on the Harmukh foothills about 6 km from Ganderbal town.

This comes from two web searches. The result summaries came back with links, but I didn't open any of the pages themselves. Each claim below cites the listing that the search summary drew it from.

**Claims and sources**

- It is in Ganderbal district, Kashmir.
  - https://ecovillage.org/map/community/sagg-eco-village/
  - https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotel_Review-g32869462-d17693204-Reviews-SAGG_Eco_Village_Kashmir-Bagh_Mahanand_Ganderbal_District_Kashmir_Jammu_and_Kashmir.html
- The address is Watlar Wuder, Lar, Ganderbal, PIN 191201.
  - https://ecovillage.org/ecovillage/sagg-eco-village/
  - https://recreation.saggecovillage.earth/
- Ganderbal town is about 6 km away.
  - https://ecoideaz.com/green-directory/sagg-eco-village-kashmir/
- Third-party listings place it in the Bagh Mahanand or Chanthan Gulabpora locality.
  - https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotel_Review-g32869462-d17693204-Reviews-SAGG_Eco_Village_Kashmir-Bagh_Mahanand_Ganderbal_District_Kashmir_Jammu_and_Kashmir.html
  - https://eldercare.nears.me/places/india/jammu-and-kashmir/chanthan-gulabpora-bagh-mahanand/home-nursing-services/sagg-eco-village-elder-care/
- The setting is the Harmukh foothills, overlooking the Sindh and Nigeen valleys. Its coordinates are about 34.272N, 74.762E.
  - https://casaclan.com/projects/sagg-eco-village-kashmir/
  - https://mapcarta.com/N5931593287
- It is billed as J&K's first eco village. Its founder is Fayaz Ahmad Dar, and its own farm supplies the food.
  - https://zeenews.india.com/india/eco-and-sustainable-tourism-kashmir-s-first-eco-village-with-mud-cottages-for-tourists-2498150.html
  - https://preciouskashmir.com/2022/09/21/sagg-eco-village-kashmirs-offbeat-recreational-destination/
- Its website says guests must pre-book and that there are no walk-ins.
  - https://recreation.saggecovillage.earth/

**Caveats**
- I did not check the coordinates on a map. They come from one search summary, which gave them only as approximate.
- The founding year is inconsistent across sources (2012 or 2013). That doesn't affect the location.
- The exact village name varies across listings (Lar, Watlar, Bagh Mahanand, Chanthan Gulabpora). They all point to the same area of Ganderbal district.
